cases.name: Hope Elizabeth Raley
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She liked to play in the sprinkler and ride her bike.  She loved dancing and learning cheers that her big sister was learning.  Hope loved going to any park that had swings and a seesaw.  She loved watching Mickey Mouse while holding her teddy bear and her baby dolls. Hope spent her days playing school with her big sister and playing with her dog.  Her favorite things to really do was to go shopping, whether it was for groceries or for fun.  Hope loved to go bowling and having a higher score than everyone else."
cases.narrative:
On 7/26/2022, law enforcement, they responded to a a suspicious house and found Hope, who was deceased on a bed.  It was determined the fire seemed to have started on the bed.
During a search of the house, Humberto Martinez was found in a crawl space. He was taken to Lubbock for smoke inhalation and later arrested for 2nd degree felony arson and then in 9/2022, charged with capital murder.

Then, in February of 2023, Diane Click, 64, was also arrested in connection with the case. She was charged with two counts of obstruction, aggravated sexual assault of a child and abandonment/endangerment of a child.
